verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party docs describe webhooks that push real-time notifications to your application when account events occur. They also document delivery semantics: endpoints must return 200, each event carries a stable `id` for idempotent retry handling, and the web app shows delivery status (success, queued, failed) and lets you re-deliver events. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to register endpoints and select event types (via API or UI), signature verification details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
